text: OVERDOSAGE No information is available on overdosage of humans. The oral LD 50 of the drug ranged from 350-920 mg/kg in mice and 860-1050 mg/kg in rats. The symptoms which might be expected with an overdose of a systemically administered beta-1-adrenergic receptor blocker agent are bradycardia, hypotension and acute cardiac failure. A topical overdose of Betaxolol Ophthalmic Solution may be flushed from the eye(s) with warm tap water.
